claim: Multi-agent collaboration increases goal success rate relative to single-agent approaches in multi-step tasks.
falsifier: Replicate the multi-agent coordination protocol on held-out multi-step tasks and compare GSR against a single-agent baseline under identical conditions.

conditions: tasks spanning travel, mortgage, and software development domains
LLM-based agents (Claude 3.5 Sonnet as supervisor, Claude 3.0 Sonnet as specialists)
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system, task domains, LLM models, and experimental conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Multi-agent collaboration–goal success rate principle
